items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Clarenette. Clarenette. Clarenette. Yes. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that Paul Barbrun? Do you remember? Paul Barbrun. Paul Barbrun also.

ctx.x: Well, they worked a long time together and things began to get bad again. Then Louie went over to the, what's the name of this, theater on, uh, State Street. State near 35th. Oh, the Vandome was that? Uh-huh. And then Dome. Louie went then over to play there. They sort of split. Joe didn't have much work and we went over there and he played. He played for a long time with, uh, I think it must have been, with, uh, Tate. Oh, yes. Yes, I knew him. Erskine Tate. Erskine Tate, right. And they played and it was quite a…

Is that Paul Barbrun? Do you remember? Paul Barbrun. Paul Barbrun also. He was playing on drums then. Yes. And they played around New York for a long time. They did fairly well but not much because men began to get tired and Ory was there too. He began to spit. He began to leave Joe. Because he wasn't so strong anymore and all that traveling around and disappointment and all. And Joe was quite disappointed.
